producer: webpack --mode production --config-name webviews:common --config-name webviews --env analyzeBundle --env quick
budgetRationale: Re-baselined for GitHub merge-queue support on top of the review-session baseline (#100): +11.7 KiB on the entrypoint, of which +8.8 KiB is graph.js and +2.9 KiB shared.js; graph.css unchanged. The growth is feature code: queued pull request state on the PR icon, chips, WIP header, branch hover, overview card, sidebar rows and PR sheet; the rule that holds Merge, Rebase Stack and branch-changing next steps while a pull request is queued (WIP empty pane, branch sheet, PR sheet, merge-target chip); the WIP pane's pausable queued-PR recheck; and their localized messages. Not a new dependency or a module moving between chunks. It left 188 bytes of headroom on the entrypoint against the review-session ceiling. Before it: review mode as a review session (+72.8 KiB, see its commit). Ceilings keep their prior headroom: 12 KiB above baseline on the entrypoint, 4 KiB on shared.js (loaded by every webview), and graph.css's accounted allowance.
